# Contract: Service Interfaces

Signatures only; bodies belong to implementation. All methods are asynchronous. Services that act on behalf of a
user take `requestingUserId` and enforce authorization internally, returning `null`/`false`/empty when not allowed.

## IFileStorageService (infrastructure abstraction)

```csharp
public interface IFileStorageService
{
    // relativePath is generated by the caller ({uploaderId}/{projectId|personal}/{guid}.{ext}); never from a user file name.
    Task<string> UploadAsync(Stream content, string relativePath, string contentType);
    Task<Stream> DownloadAsync(string relativePath);
    Task DeleteAsync(string relativePath);
    Task<string> GetUrlAsync(string relativePath, TimeSpan expiration);   // local impl returns the app's authorized endpoint path
}
```
- `LocalFileStorageService`: root `DocumentStorage:RootPath` (default `AppData/uploads`); rejects rooted paths and `..`.
- Future `AzureBlobStorageService` swaps in via DI with no change to callers.

## IFileContentValidator (local content check)

```csharp
public interface IFileContentValidator
{
    Task<FileValidationResult> ValidateAsync(string fileName, string declaredContentType, Stream content, long length);
}
public record FileValidationResult(bool IsValid, string? ErrorMessage);
```
Checks: allow-listed extension, size (0 < length <= 25 MB), magic number matches extension, text has no NUL bytes,
dangerous signatures (executables, shebang) rejected.

## IDocumentService

```csharp
public interface IDocumentService
{
    // Upload & management
    Task<DocumentUploadResult> UploadAsync(int requestingUserId, DocumentUploadRequest request, Stream content);
    Task<bool> UpdateMetadataAsync(int requestingUserId, int documentId, DocumentMetadata metadata);
    Task<bool> ReplaceFileAsync(int requestingUserId, int documentId, string fileName, string contentType, Stream content);
    Task<bool> DeleteAsync(int requestingUserId, int documentId);                  // permanent, file + metadata

    // Reading
    Task<PagedResult<DocumentSummary>> GetMyDocumentsAsync(int requestingUserId, DocumentQuery query);
    Task<PagedResult<DocumentSummary>> GetProjectDocumentsAsync(int requestingUserId, int projectId, DocumentQuery query);
    Task<PagedResult<DocumentSummary>> GetTaskDocumentsAsync(int requestingUserId, int taskId, DocumentQuery query);
    Task<PagedResult<DocumentSummary>> GetSharedWithMeAsync(int requestingUserId, DocumentQuery query);
    Task<PagedResult<DocumentSummary>> SearchAsync(int requestingUserId, string term, DocumentQuery query);
    Task<DocumentDetail?> GetDocumentAsync(int requestingUserId, int documentId);

    // File access (used by the HTTP endpoints; records the activity)
    Task<DocumentFile?> OpenForDownloadAsync(int requestingUserId, int documentId);
    Task<DocumentFile?> OpenForPreviewAsync(int requestingUserId, int documentId);   // null unless PDF/image

    // Sharing
    Task<bool> ShareWithUserAsync(int requestingUserId, int documentId, int targetUserId);
    Task<bool> ShareWithDepartmentAsync(int requestingUserId, int documentId, string department);
    Task<bool> AttachToTaskAsync(int requestingUserId, int documentId, int taskId);

    // Dashboard
    Task<List<DocumentSummary>> GetRecentDocumentsAsync(int requestingUserId, int count = 5);
    Task<int> GetDocumentCountAsync(int requestingUserId);
}
```

Supporting types (shape only):
- `DocumentUploadRequest`: `Title`, `FileName`, `ContentType`, `Category`, `Description?`, `ProjectId?`, `TaskId?`, `Tags`.
- `DocumentUploadResult`: `Success`, `DocumentId?`, `ErrorMessage?` (one result per file in a batch).
- `DocumentQuery`: `Category?`, `ProjectId?`, `From?`, `To?`, `SortBy` (Title | UploadedDate | Category | FileSize), `Descending`, `Page`, `PageSize` (default 50).
- `DocumentSummary`: id, title, category, uploaded date, size, project name, uploader name.
- `DocumentFile`: `Stream`, `FileName`, `ContentType`.

Authorization is applied inside every method (research D4). Rejected uploads store nothing.

## IDocumentReportService (Administrator only; the service re-checks the role)

```csharp
public interface IDocumentReportService
{
    Task<List<DocumentTypeCount>> GetTopDocumentTypesAsync(int requestingUserId, DateTime? from, DateTime? to);
    Task<List<UploaderCount>> GetMostActiveUploadersAsync(int requestingUserId, DateTime? from, DateTime? to);
    Task<List<AccessPatternRow>> GetAccessPatternsAsync(int requestingUserId, DateTime? from, DateTime? to);
}
```
Non-administrators receive empty results.

## Existing contracts touched

- `INotificationService.CreateNotificationAsync` reused for `DocumentShared` and `DocumentAdded`.
- `IDashboardService` / `DashboardData`: add recent documents and document count.
- DI registrations in `Program.cs`: `IFileStorageService`, `IFileContentValidator`, `IDocumentService`, `IDocumentReportService` (scoped).
